title: Explainable Fault Detection and Isolation for Fixed-Wing UAVs Using Physics-Informed Residuals: code and results
description: MATLAB code and results for leave-one-flight-out evaluation of physics-informed residual features, a bagged-tree fault detection and isolation model and a SHAP explanation audit on the ALFA fixed-wing UAV dataset.
